sloka: यस्य यज्ञैर्यथोद्दिष्टैर्युक्तो धर्मस्य सञ्चय:।शरीरक्लेशसम्भूतं स धर्मं परिमार्गते ॥ २.९९.३४॥
transliteration: yasya yajñairyathoddiṣṭairyukto dharmasya sañcaya:।śarīrakleśasambhūtaṁ sa dharmaṁ parimārgate ॥ 2.99.34॥

translations.english: That Rama, who in accordance with tradition deserves accredition of religious merit through sacrifices now seeks it through mortification of body.
